content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 9.0(f) is the Agreement's only non-solicitation covenant and it binds IBM (our client) alone, for "[*] years" from the Effective Date, across all Transferred Employees. That fails the playbook fallback on mutuality, scope and duration, so I classified it as a deviation and proposed a single surgical replacement of the restriction sentence — making it mutual, limiting it to the other party's personnel directly involved in performing the Agreement, and capping it at 12 months after that involvement ends. The clause already satisfies the remaining fallback elements (solicitation-only with no no-hire, plus unsolicited-approach and general-advertising carve-outs), so those were left verbatim and mapped as already met.
